cases.name: Two roles at one employer
cases.prompt: At Cedar Studio I applied to Ops Lead requisition 17 on May 2 and Ops Analyst requisition 19 on May 4. Requisition 19 has an interview booked May 10.
expectations: Maintains separate rows for requisitions 17 and 19.
Assigns the scheduled interview only to 19.
Lists May 10 as a future interview rather than a completed one.

cases.name: Ambiguous update
cases.prompt: My log has two product coordinator jobs with the same company. They emailed a rejection but I have no job ID in the note.
expectations: Shows that two records could match.
Leaves both current stages intact pending confirmation.
Asks for distinguishing text, requisition or date.
Captures the rejection as unresolved rather than losing the event.

cases.name: Status report and reminder
cases.prompt: Three applications this month, one reached interviews. Put a reminder in my calendar to follow up Friday; this client has no calendar.
expectations: Reports one of three applications reaching interviews.
Identifies the time window as this month.
Offers a copyable follow-up reminder and clarifies its date if needed.
Does not claim a calendar event was created.
